security.postgresPointer: Encryption at rest protects the local database file (PGlite). This installation uses PostgreSQL, so protecting the data volume is up to your server infrastructure — see the documentation (https://gekkotron.github.io/Athena-Accounting/docs/users/encryption-at-rest) for the recommended setup (disk encryption, encrypted backups).
